# Third-party notices — Swedish autocorrect & dictation (app module)

Applies to the `sv-app-extras` branch only (the sideload build). The upstream
layout branches contain no third-party code.

**Code** — adapted from [KEZO555/Type](https://github.com/KEZO555/Type) (fork of
[adam-weber/light-keyboard](https://github.com/adam-weber/light-keyboard)), MIT,
© 2026 Adam Weber: `SvCorrector`, `VoiceModel`, `VoiceDictation`,
`MicPermissionActivity`.

**Swedish dictionary** (`app/src/main/assets/sv_words.txt`, generated by
`tools/make_sv_dictionary.sh`) — derived from the
[HeliBoard experimental Swedish wordlist](https://codeberg.org/Helium314/aosp-dictionaries),
built from the [Leipzig Corpora Collection](https://wortschatz.uni-leipzig.de/en/download/),
CC BY 4.0. Cite: Goldhahn, Eckart & Quasthoff, LREC 2012.

**Swedish speech model** (downloaded on demand, not distributed here) —
[vosk-model-small-sv-rhasspy-0.15](https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models), MIT.

**Library** — [Vosk](https://alphacephei.com/vosk/) (`com.alphacephei:vosk-android`), Apache 2.0.
